name: ink-wash-poster
title_zh: 把任意素材变成一张水墨编辑海报与配图
tagline_zh: 一句诗、一张照片、一段回忆，都能落成有纸纹、留白克制的海报。它先写提示词再出图，构图和排版替你拿捏，不靠撞大运。
tagline_en: Turn a line, photo, or memory into a quiet, spacious ink-wash poster. It drafts the prompt first, then renders.
desc_en: Generate an ink-wash editorial poster prompt and the matching bitmap image from a user's theme, sentence, object, mood, article idea, photo, content brief, poem, memory, event, place, or other creative material. Use when the user wants a quiet, spacious, tactile ink-wash poster, cover, cultural visual, or reference-photo reinterpretation with thoughtful composition, paper texture, restrained typog
why_zh: 提示词与位图分两步走：先锁定构图与字型，再生成画面，避免文生图常见的失控。纸纹与留白是内置默认。
why_en: Two-step pipeline: lock the prompt with composition and typography first, then render the image—taming text-to-image drift.
limit_zh: 只输出单张竖版编辑海报风格，不处理多页、横版或动态。依赖外部图像生成 API，本机无模型；若素材是纯音频或视频。
limit_en: Single vertical editorial poster only—no multi-page, landscape, or motion. Requires an external image API (no local model). Pure audio/video input.
title_en: Turn any material into an ink-wash editorial poster with.
